# Newznab fixtures

```json
{"_fixture": "handwritten-from-docs"}
```

No indexer account was used: **none of these files is a recorded response**.
They are written by hand from the examples of the Newznab API documentation and
the Torznab specification (https://torznab.github.io/spec-1.3-draft/, fetched on
2026-11-05), with realistic movie titles and values.

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `caps.xml` | caps example of the Torznab spec (Newznab layout: retention, groups, supportedParams from revision 1.1), movie categories from the predefined category list |
| `caps_legacy.xml` | a server without `supportedParams` nor `movie-search`, to exercise the revision 1.1 client defaults |
| `movie_search.xml` | MOVIE-SEARCH example 1, completed with the attributes of the predefined attribute list (`usenetdate`, `imdb`, `tmdbid`, `grabs`); the third item has no title and must be skipped |
| `rss.xml` | SEARCH example 1 layout (no `q`), four items newest first |
| `empty.xml` | SEARCH example 2, verbatim (undeclared `newznab:` prefix included) |
| `error_*.xml` | error example 3 layout with the codes of the error code table (100, 101, 203, 910); `429` and `500` "Request limit reached" are the variants used by indexers for API limits |
| `html.html` | a login page, as served by a wrong URL or a reverse proxy |

Large, slow and paginated responses are generated by the tests.
